event_description: A user successfully authenticated to the experiment dashboard.
An authenticated user signed out of the experiment dashboard.
An administrator created a new A/B test experiment.
An administrator updated an existing experiment configuration.
An administrator started, paused, completed, republished, or kill-switched experiments.
The experiment wizard completed analysis of storefront theme variants.
An administrator completed a step in the new-experiment workflow.
The authenticated storefront snapshot endpoint could not fetch a usable page.
Storefront visitor exposed to an A/B experiment variant. Sent server-side from the app proxy with $feature_flag = tl-ab-<experimentId> and $feature_flag_response = control|test.
Exposed visitor viewed a product page (storefront, server-relayed).
Exposed visitor added a product to cart (storefront, server-relayed).
Exposed visitor started checkout (web pixel, server-relayed). Funnel step, not a conversion.
Exposed visitor completed checkout (web pixel, server-relayed). Funnel step, not a conversion.
Order paid for an exposed visitor, from the orders/paid webhook. Source of truth for conversion, revenue per visitor and AOV metrics.
A previously paid order was cancelled (orders/cancelled webhook).
A refund was issued on a paid order (refunds/create webhook). Guardrail metric.
Browser and server disagreed on a visitor's variant. Pipeline guardrail; any occurrence invalidates the experiment.
